GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS 
DEPARTMENT OF FERTILIZERS 
 
LOK SABHA 
 
STARRED QUESTION NO. 498* TO BE ANSWERED ON: 04.04.2025 
 
Sale of Inferior Quality Fertilizers 
 
498*:  SHRI BRIJENDRA SINGH OLA: 
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state: 
(a) whether the Government has taken note that companies often sell fake or 
 inferior quality fertilizers to farmers which harms their crops; 
 
(b) if so, the number of such cases reported during the last five years, State -
 wise including Rajasthan; 
 
(c) whether any action has been taken by the Government against such 
 fraudulent companies; 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof indicating the names of such companies and the 
 action taken against them, State-wise; 
 
(e) whether the Government has provided compensation or any other financial 
 assistance to the farmers affected by such incidents; and 
 
(f) if so, the details thereof along with the amount of funds provided to them on 
 this account and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER FOR CHEMICALS & FERTILIZERS AND HEALTH & FAMILY WELFARE 
(SHRI JAGAT PRAKASH NADDA) 
 
(a) to (f):  A statement is laid on the table of the House. 
 
        ********** 
 
 
 
 
 
 

-2-  
 
STATEMENT REFERRED TO LOK SABHA STARRED QUESTION NO. 498* FOR 
04.04.2025 REGARDING “ SALE OF INFERIOR QUALITY FERTILIZERS ” 
TABLED BY SHRI BRIJENDRA SINGH OLA. 
______  
 
(a) to (f):   Fertilizer Control Order (FCO)-1985 has laid down fertilizer -wise detailed 
specifications. Any fertilizer, not meeting the said specifications, cannot be sold in 
the country for agricultural purpose. Clause 19 of FCO strictly prohibits the sale or 
manufacture of fertilizers which are not of prescribed standards.  
 
 In case of sale of fake/inferior/substandard fertilizers, State Governments are 
empowered to invoke administrative action  under FCO – 1985 and penal action 
under Essential Commodities Act, 195 5. Further, any complaints received on such 
matters are forwarded to State Governments for taking necessary action. 
 
 The Government releases subsidy to fertilizer manufacturing/importing 
companies for providing fertilizers at subsidized prices to the farm ers. As per 
existing guidelines , if any discrepancy is reported by States in the quality of 
fertilizers, recoveries are made from the pending claims of the company.     
 
 As per the information received from Agriculture Departments of States & 
UTs, including the state of Rajasthan, the details regarding number of fake fertilizer 
cases reported, number of inferior/sub -standard fertilizer cases reported and action 
taken by the States from 2019-20 till 2024-25 is placed at Annexure.

entries.t: Ayushman Bharat Yojana in Tamil Nadu
entries.head:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND FAMILYWELFARE
DEPARTMENTOF HEALTH AND FAMILYWELFARE
LOK SABHA
STARRED QUESTION NO. 499
TO BE ANSWERED ON THE 4TH APRIL, 2025
AYUSHMANBHARAT YOJANAIN TAMILNADU
*499. SHRI THARANIVENTHAN M S:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILYWELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the status of implementation of Ayushman Bharat Yojana including the number of beneficiaries covered
under the said scheme in Tamil Nadu including Arani district so far;
(b) the number of Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centers (AB-HWCs) established in Tamil Nadu
including Arani district alongwith their distribution across urban and rural areas;
(c) the efforts made by the Government to raise awareness about the Ayushman Bharat scheme among the
people especially in remote and rural areas of Arani district in Tamil Nadu;
(d) the financial assistance provided to eligible families under the Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
(PM-JAY), a component of the Ayushman Bharat Yojana in Tamil Nadu alongwith the details of treatments
covered thereunder; and
(e) the plans to expand the Ayushman Bharat Yojana in Tamil Nadu including the increase in the number of
hospitals and beneficiaries under the scheme?
ANSWER
THE MINISTER OF HEALTH AND FAMILYWELFARE
(SHRI JAGAT PRAKASH NADDA)
(a) to (e) A Statement is laid on the Table of the House.

STATEMENTREFERRED TO IN REPLY TO LOK SABHA
STARRED QUESTION NO. 499 FOR 4TH APRIL, 2025
In the State of Tamil Nadu, Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) is
implemented in convergence with the State-specific scheme, Chief Minister’s Comprehensive Health
Insurance Scheme, and is operationalized in Insurance mode.
A total of 1.71 crore beneficiary families are eligible for healthcare benefits under the converged scheme,
out of which 1.16 crore families are supported by the Central and State governments together under
AB-PMJAY .The rest of the families are exclusively supported by the State.
Arani is a Parliamentary Constituency in Tiruvannamalai District of Tamil Nadu. Parliamentary
Constituency-wise data is not captured under the scheme; however, district-wise data is available. A total of
3.5 lakh beneficiary families are covered in Tiruvannamalai District of Tamil Nadu.
Number of Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (AAMs) operationalized in the State of Tamil Nadu including Arani
block are as under:

The Government raises awareness through large-scale IEC campaigns and Ayushman card creation drives
ensuring outreach to eligible beneficiaries, especially in remote and rural areas.
AB-PMJAY is a flagship scheme of the Government which provides health cover of Rs. 5 lakh per eligible
beneficiary family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization in 27 different medical specialties
corresponding to 1961 procedures.
The Government of India encourages States/UTs to empanel more hospitals under the scheme to ensure
greater access to quality healthcare to all eligible beneficiaries. As on date, a total of 30,957 empanelled
hospitals, including 13,866 private hospitals and 17,091 public hospitals, have been empanelled across the
country under the scheme, including 1,225 private hospitals and 1,020 public hospitals in the State of Tamil
Nadu.
Further, regular updation such as expansion of beneficiary base, inclusion of new procedures, empanelment
of new hospitals and other improvements are done in the scheme as per requirements from time to time.
